### code_and_ci_with_failure_feedback
keywords: write code, ci workflow file, zip, extract, commit, push, watch run, failure log, fix loop
Status: unverified; successes=0; failures=0; runs=0
Steps: browser.type (ask the LLM for the code plus a CI workflow file, as one zip) > browser.click (download zip; detector file_appears) > storage.unzip > shell.run (init, add, commit, set remote) > shell.run (push; high risk) > detector ci_run > if failed: browser.read the failure log > browser.type (send the log, ask for a fixed zip) > storage.unzip, repeat

### resume_after_usage_limit_resets
keywords: usage limit, quota, reset time, wait, schedule, resume, later
Status: unverified; successes=0; failures=0; runs=0
Steps: browser.read (find the limit message and the reset time) > work out the timestamp from the shown time and NOW_EPOCH > wait.until (until_ts) > browser.type (the resume message) > detector page_text (work continues). The LLM is not called while waiting.

### download_process_export_files
keywords: download, archive, extract, process, convert, export, files
Status: unverified; successes=0; failures=0; runs=0
Steps: browser.navigate > browser.click (download; detector file_appears) > storage.unzip (if an archive) > storage.list > shell.run (process the files; the exit code is the result) > storage.export (the result). If the command fails, read its output and change the command.

### wait_for_remote_job_by_status_check
keywords: long job, status check, poll, ready, finished, result, remote task
Status: unverified; successes=0; failures=0; runs=0
Steps: shell.run or browser.click (start the job) > detector http_json (status field equals finished; set timeout_s) > browser.navigate or storage.write (fetch the result) > storage.export. No LLM calls while waiting; on timeout ask_user whether to wait longer.

### account_sign_in_handoff_and_key_capture
keywords: sign in, login, verification, captcha, api key, token, vault, secret
Status: unverified; successes=0; failures=0; runs=0
Steps: browser.navigate (sign-in page) > detector page_text (sign-in form) > ask_user (the user signs in; never bypass captcha or verification) > browser.wait_for (signed-in text) > for a key: ask_user creates and copies it > browser.capture_secret (into the vault) > later steps use {{vault:Title.field}} with browser.type_secret.
